he: שלב 3: להוסיף תערובת מרק בצל, מרגרינה וברוקולי קצוץ. לערבב היטב.

ocrRawText:
Madeline's
Broccoli Noodle Pudding
1 lb (400-500 gr) noodles (med)
300- gram Broccoli (chopped)
3-5 Eggs - Beaten
100 grams margarine
3-4 Tbsp onion soup
1 cup liquid (parve water or
dairy milk or)

Cook noodles and drain
melt margarine into noodles
Add soup mix and chopped
Broccoli. Mix thoroughly.
Mix in liquid. add Beaten
eggs. mix thoroughly.
Bake in a 9x13 greased Pan
at 350° for approx. 30 min
until set and golden.
Can substitute chopped
cauliflower
